relatedItems.titleZh: 奥孔将在2026赛季结束后离开哈斯车队
relatedItems.summaryZh: 车手和车队均已确认，埃斯特班·奥孔将在2026赛季结束后离开哈斯车队。奥孔自2025赛季从阿尔派加盟，明年第7赛季席位悬而未决，这意味着他目前没有2027赛季的车手席位。

relatedItems.originalTitle: Ocon to leave Haas at end of 2026 season
relatedItems.summaryEn: Esteban Ocon will leave Haas at the end of the 2026 Formula 1 season, as confirmed by both the driver and the team. The Frenchman joined Haas from Alpine for the 2025 season and now looks set to be without a drive for the 2027 season.
